NONE: › a fixed point supporting something that turns or balances
› the central or most important person or thing in a situation

example: The former guerrilla leader has become the pivot on which the country's emerging political stability turns/revolves (= it depends on him).
前游擊隊領袖成了決定該國的政治局勢能否繼續穩定下去的關鍵人物。
He pivoted on his heels and headed out.
Future deals will pivot on (= depend on) easing commercial conflicts.
未來的協議將取決於疏緩商業衝突。
